prompt:
You review onboarding copy for a desktop pet app whose users may include children. For each change,
read every user-facing text and decide whether any of it, in any wording, does one of these:
- mentions price, money, discounts, gifts, free extras, memberships or paying
- suggests skipping, postponing or getting around a step (especially sign in)
- creates urgency or scarcity, or says others are taking the pets
- guilt-trips or shames someone for declining or for their choice
- asks for personal information about the user (name, contact, location, age, accounts)
- otherwise pressures or tricks the user
Ordinary friendly copy is fine ("Feel free to look around", "No rush, take your time"). Signing in is a
required step, so asking people to sign in on the sign-in step, or saying their pet is kept safe in their
account, is fine; asking for details about the person is not.
Return JSON {"verdicts": [{"index": i, "fair": true or false, "problem": short or null}]}

Texts per change:
0: ["Signing into your existing account automatically restores all your saved pets and desktop preferences."]
1: ["How to Care for Your Pet", "Learn the basics of feeding, playing, and managing your companion on your desktop.", "Click to play, drag to reposition, right-click for settings menu."]
2: ["Preparing your desktop pet... Checking screen resolution and asset rendering."]
3: ["Photo Quality Check", "Ensure clear lighting and front-facing photos for optimal 3D pet rendering."]
4: ["Press Ctrl+Shift+P to instantly show or hide your pet on your desktop."]
5: ["Meet Your New Desktop Companion", "Choose from a gallery of ready-to-play pets or generate a custom pet from your own photos."]
6: ["Choose Your Desktop Friend", "Select a companion to see their live animations and unique personalities."]
7: ["If your pet does not appear on screen in 30 seconds, check your system tray menu to enable overlay mode."]
8: ["Sign In to Protect Your Pets", "Logging into your account securely backs up your companion data and restores previously adopted pets."]
9: ["Quick Desktop Practice", "Try moving your pet and opening the quick menu to complete onboarding."]
